item.title: Over two-thirds of UK workers now admit to pretending to be well at work Rising pleasanteeism exposes hidden health risk, and a growing data gap for UK employers
item.description: Nearly seven in ten UK employees are now pretending to be well at work when they are not, according to new research from Lime Health, marking a sharp increase from 51% reported in 2021.
